title: Realtime
outcome: Add realtime synchronization without creating a second source of truth or leaking unauthorized events.
artifact: Realtime task updates that merge into TanStack Query state with scoped subscriptions and reconnect behavior.
labSteps: Choose the exact collaborative event that benefits from realtime rather than subscribing to everything.
Create a channel scoped to workspace/board context and define subscription lifecycle.
Feed events into query cache updates or invalidation instead of a parallel global store.
Deduplicate events that echo the current user's own mutation.
Test disconnect/reconnect and ensure a fresh server query repairs any missed events.
Verify authorization/data exposure boundaries for every subscription filter/channel.
failureModes: Events for other tenants visible to a client
mastery: Can reconcile realtime with server cache
principles: Realtime is a synchronization mechanism, not the authoritative database.
Subscribe only to events relevant to the current user and resource scope.
Design reconnect and duplicate-event behavior so clients can recover after temporary disconnection.
Reconcile realtime events with cached server state rather than maintaining an unrelated second data model.
